## Problem and resulting change

Explain the concrete problem and what readers or users will see after this change.

## Component and source

Identify the affected component, edition or commit, and files. If this adds a corrected source edition or new evidence, link its correspondence record and the retained original.

## Validation

List the commands or review steps performed, their results, and any checks not run. Keep source-integrity, software-test, written-proof, and Lean results distinct.

## Remaining limits or follow-up (if applicable)

State unresolved assumptions, platform limitations, or downstream records that still need attention. Link related issues or finalization items.
